final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN '(missing)' WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '(blank)' ELSE p.SEX END AS sex, COUNT(*) AS examined_count FROM Examination AS e LEFT JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY 1), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examined_count) AS overall_count, AVG(examined_count) AS per_sex_average FROM sex_counts), results AS (SELECT 0 AS sort_order, sex, examined_count, 100.0 * examined_count / overall_count AS share_pct, NULL AS average_above_per_sex_average FROM sex_counts CROSS JOIN totals UNION ALL SELECT 1, '(above-average sexes combined)', SUM(examined_count), AVG(100.0 * examined_count / overall_count), AVG(examined_count - per_sex_average) FROM sex_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE examined_count > per_sex_average) SELECT sex, examined_count, share_pct, average_above_per_sex_average FROM results ORDER BY sort_order, sex
